episodes.instruction: Grab the cylindrical mug with Starbucks logo on the table, rotate it, set it down in the middle, then hang it onto the rack with straight and slanted rods.
Lift the printed beige mug, rotate it, put it down, then attach it to the dark gray rack with flat back.
Pick the mug with smooth texture with the left arm, rotate, place it, then hang it on the dark gray rack with flat back.
